newsitem.title: USA: NYSE says to delist Alliance Entertainment.
newsitem.headline: NYSE says to delist Alliance Entertainment.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said Thursday it is immediately suspending trading in the common stock of Alliance Entertainment Corp, and it will apply to the Securities and Exchange Commission to delist the issue.
NYSE said the company has fallen below its continued listing criteria.

It said Alliances net tangible assets available to common stockholders is less than $12 million, average net income for the last three years is less than $600,000, and aggregate market value of publicly held shares is less than $8 million .
It also said Alliance filed a voluntary petition for bankruptcy under Chapter 11 of the Federal Bankruptcy Code.
